biotools.summary: CellRegulonDB is an atlas of transcription factor-driven gene programs across human cells, based on single-cell data from the Human Cell Atlas. It provides researchers with a resource to understand gene regulation, link disease signatures, and explore enhancer-gene regulatory networks.
